_comment: Fail-closed path classification for bin/select-random-order-scope (docs/specs/ci-test-selection.md §3.3). A changed path matching no entry here and no packages/*/ or tests/** rule selects the complete inventory. Every prefixes entry needs a rationale; protected entries force the complete inventory.

prefixes.rationale: documentation cannot change PHP behaviour; spec drift is gated separately
workflow shape is proven by tests/Architecture, which is always run; ci.yml and nightly.yml are in protected

most repo tooling is proven only by tests/Architecture, which is always run, EXCEPT packages/testing/tests/Unit/SkeletonSyncRequirementsScriptTest.php, which exec()s tools/sync-skeleton-requirements.php directly — a Unit test in the testing package group, not always-run. Seeding testing covers that; selector inputs are in protected

most gate scripts are proven only by tests/Architecture, which is always run, EXCEPT packages/foundation/tests/Unit/LayerDependencyTest.php::srcScanExemptionsAreMirroredInCheckPackageLayersAllowlist, which reads bin/check-package-layers as text — a Unit test in the foundation package group, not always-run. Seeding foundation covers that; selector scripts are in protected
the CLI entry point is additionally exercised by the cli package suite

documentation cannot change PHP behaviour; a changelog entry is mandated on every PR, so leaving it unclassified would make the selector inert. Repo-state contracts that read this file live in tests/Architecture, which is always run
